title: Grade 3 Science — Wed, Jun 03
description: Animal Life — Day 3 of 5: How animals move and eat
subject: science

questions.question: Animals that eat only plants are called:
questions.explanation: Herbivores, like cows and goats, eat only plants.

questions.question: Animals that eat only other animals are called:
questions.explanation: Carnivores, like lions and tigers, eat the flesh of other animals.

questions.question: Animals that eat both plants and animals are called:
questions.explanation: Omnivores, like crows and bears, eat both plants and animals.

questions.question: How does a fish move in water?
options: By using fins and tail to swim
questions.explanation: Fish use their fins and tail to swim through water.

questions.question: Which animal moves by slithering (crawling on its belly)?
questions.explanation: Snakes have no legs and move by slithering along the ground.

questions.question: A frog moves on land by:
questions.explanation: Frogs have strong back legs and hop or jump on land.

questions.question: A cow is a herbivore. Which of these does it eat?
questions.explanation: A cow is a herbivore that eats grass and other plants.

questions.question: Sharp teeth and claws are usually found in:
questions.explanation: Carnivores have sharp teeth and claws to catch and tear their prey.

questions.question: Which animal uses its trunk to pick up food and water?
questions.explanation: An elephant uses its long trunk to pick up food and drink water.

questions.question: A bird like a sparrow moves through the air by:
questions.explanation: Sparrows and most birds fly using their wings.

questions.question: A lion is a carnivore. This means a lion eats:
questions.explanation: A lion is a carnivore that hunts and eats other animals.

questions.question: Which of these animals can both swim in water and walk on land?
questions.explanation: A frog can swim in water and hop on land — it lives both in water and on land.

questions.question: A goat eating leaves and a tiger eating a deer shows that animals:
questions.explanation: Different animals eat different foods — some eat plants, some eat animals, and some eat both.

questions.question: A snail moves slowly by:
questions.explanation: A snail slides slowly on its soft muscular foot, leaving a slimy trail.

questions.question: A crow eats both fruits and insects. A crow is therefore a/an:
questions.explanation: Because a crow eats both plants (fruits) and animals (insects), it is an omnivore.
